Resolves #21465

Containers & Layouts had no card on `dev`, only the form-layout tile. It now opens on two: **Layouts Side by Side**, a new page that sets fit, hbox, vbox, flexbox, grid, card and cube over the same six items, with `align`, `pack` and `flex` live on the three Flexbox frames and **Next item** stepping the card and turning the cube; and the existing **Cube Layout** example, which had no record. Both have covers taken by their recipes (`captureExamples.mjs --family layouts`), shipped in neomjs/pages#129, and the group's sentence now says what it shows.

Evidence: L3 (component, unit and catalog e2e specs in CI; covers captured twice to the same bytes; frames of the group page released and changed) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: the frames below at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844. Measured at 1280 × 720: every stage holds its items inside the frame (fit's five hidden items are its design, per `Fit.css`); at 390 no element passes the viewport's right edge. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `component/layout/SideBySide.spec.mjs` reads the hbox and vbox items' rects after `align: start` and `pack: end`, checks that `flex: 1` fills the row in equal shares, and hit-tests the cube's centre after Next item. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (Containers & Layouts counts `[3, 0]`, the catalog order) and `unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` (both recipes validate against the catalog). Outside-CI: the changed group page below; the covers in neomjs/pages#129. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (121 records, 103 published) and `e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` (103 live examples, 102 in dev mode). |

## Deltas from ticket

- **`captureExamples.mjs`:** a tile (`kind: 'component'`) needs no recipe in a declared family, since `layout-form` is this group's tile. The hunk is the same line and docblock as #21458 and #21464, so whichever merges first, the others apply clean.
- **The page's builders are static methods on the class,** after the module-scope ruling (`check-class-module-scope`), although that guard scans `src/` only.
- **The card frame does not slide.** With `slideDirection` set, two quick Next item clicks left the card mid-slide on the wrong item: `Neo.layout.Card#slideCards` is not re-entrant. Out of scope, noted in defect-note `f3db7cb6`.
- **The two records sit at the catalog's end,** after the tiles, named in the order spec as `layoutExampleIds`.
- **The cube's recipe sets its sides to 200 px before the shot:** at 300 the turned cube is taller than the 360 px region.

## Test Evidence

Two `captureExamples.mjs --family layouts` runs wrote the same sha256 for both covers (listed in neomjs/pages#129). The changed frames route the two cover URLs to the captured files, since the Portal reads covers from pages' `main`. Rebased on `dev` at `688c26a81f`, whose new grid and chart examples move the catalog pins to 121 records and 103 published. The two layout recipes follow the three new chart recipes in the capture manifest.

Frames, released (`dev` at `e2272a9f2b`) and changed, on the dark theme the covers and the page now open in (`e98ba1102f`, `576f8c7927`). The light frames of the first review stay at `adcaf5b018`.

## Cold look

Two readers without this session's context graded the unlabelled frames from 1 to 10 (how well a newcomer understands within ten seconds what the page shows and what to do), the second reader with the order swapped:

| | Reader 1 (released shown first) | Reader 2 (changed shown first) |
|---|---|---|
| Group page, released → changed, 1440 | 4 → 8 | 3 → 8 |
| `examples/layout/sideBySide` (new), 1440 | 9 | 9 |

Both read the page at once as seven layouts over the same six items, changed live by the controls. What they missed: which `align` and `pack` button is active (the pressed state is subtle), and why hbox and flexbox look alike until the row runs out of room, which the flexbox line says. On the group page, the side-by-side cover ends mid-frame with a sliver of the next frame at its edge, the cube card's line ends in an ellipsis, and the form-layout tile does not read at its size. The released page read as unfinished: one tile under a sentence that names five layouts.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [x] After neomjs/pages#129 is deployed, both cards on `/examples/layouts` show their covers. Checked 19 Nov at the URL layer: `dev`'s catalog names `devmode/layouts-side-by-side-14.jpg` and `devmode/layout-cube-14.jpg`, and both return 200 from pages' `main` (44,602 and 43,106 bytes), the base the Portal reads outside the pages tree. The deployed Portal takes the cards with the next release.
